name: vscode-git-tool
description: Commit graph, branches, worktrees, changelists with per-file checkboxes, annotate and history, and GitLab/GitHub merge requests and issues, in Git tool windows inspired by PyCharm.

gitTool.showBranchInStatusBar.description: Show the current branch on the right of the status bar; click it for the branches popup.

gitTool.updateMethod.description: How Pull integrates the upstream branch (local changes are stashed and restored automatically).

gitTool.hostingProviders.markdownDescription: Hosting service of a remote host, for **Open in Browser** and the **Merge Requests** and **Issues** views, e.g. `{"git.example.com": "github"}` for a GitHub Enterprise server. Without an entry, `github.com` and `bitbucket.org` are recognised, and any other host is taken as a GitLab instance.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Sign in to list the open merge requests (GitLab) or pull requests (GitHub) of this repository.
[Sign In / Set Access Token…](command:gitTool.mergeRequests.signIn)
If the glab or gh command-line tool is installed, logging in with `glab auth login` or `gh auth login` also works: then refresh the view.

Sign in to list the open issues of this repository (GitLab or GitHub).
[Sign In / Set Access Token…](command:gitTool.mergeRequests.signIn)
If the glab or gh command-line tool is installed, logging in with `glab auth login` or `gh auth login` also works: then refresh the view.
